package.description: A solution to relocate render jobs from the pCon.planner workstation to a separate rendering engine, which is located on a separate system.

en-US.description: A solution to relocate render jobs from the pCon.planner workstation to a separate rendering engine, which is located on a separate system.
en-US.longDescription: The pCon.planner – Batch Rendering Service is a solution to relocate render jobs from the pCon.planner workstation to a separate rendering engine, which is located on a separate system. By that the capacities of the pCon.planner workstation are not blocked by rendering and the user can continue their planning activities as usual and without limitations.
en-US.name: pCon.planner - Batch Rendering Service

zh-CN.description: 可将渲染任务从 pCon.planner 工作站转移至独立系统中的专用渲染引擎的解决方案。
zh-CN.longDescription: pCon.planner – 批量渲染服务是一项解决方案，可将渲染任务从 pCon.planner 工作站转移至独立系统中的专用渲染引擎。由此释放工作站资源，用户可不受限制地继续常规规划工作。
